reconciliation.safe_composition: Display fixture-only EB0.4 known-behaviour operation summaries beside separately labelled PSI0E aggregate evidence availability context.
reconciliation.unsafe_composition: Infer operation-specific evidence coverage, identity, performance, risk, ranking or policy from PSI0E aggregate coverage.

next_milestone.name: Pure fixture-only known-behaviour operational-surface contract
immutable_inputs: Caller-injected frozen synthetic PSI0E envelope summary with exact lineage, five surface aggregates, ABSENT_NOT_NEGATIVE semantics, duplicate/conflict/unmatched accounting, default_off=true, consumer_enabled=false and false authority.

Caller-injected frozen synthetic EB0.4 operational-family summary with PLATFORM_OPERATION_ID, primary role, nomination state, supporting fact identities, shared edge/mechanism/temporal descriptors, versioned sources, quality, completeness, conflicts and false operator-identity authority.
Explicit fixture_only=true marker and deterministic contract identities.

content: Canonical operation and nomination counts grouped by primary role
Explicit shared edge, mechanism and temporal descriptors
Supporting fact and source counts without source payload values
Separately labelled PSI0E aggregate availability context
Deterministic reason codes, canonical bytes and replay digest

required_tests: Complete, partial and empty operational-family fixtures
Duplicate, conflict, orphan and unmatched preservation
Missing, extra, stale, malformed or altered lineage and schema
Operator identity, attribution, threshold, rank, score, policy, selection, profitability and cashflow rejection
Input-order independence, canonical replay and tamper rejection
Pure no-I/O, default-off and source-value non-retention proof
stop_conditions: Need to read the real PSI0E or EB0.4 bundle
Need for operation-specific linkage absent from immutable inputs
Identity, attribution, ranking, scoring, policy or selection inference
Authority drift, I/O or scope expansion

approval_sequence: PSI0F-B: separately authorize fixture-only pure contract qualification.
PSI0F-C: separately authorize replay-verified qualification closure.
Only after closure, separately reconcile whether a local adapter to immutable real summaries is coherent.
Any real application, publication, integration, deployment, Evidence mode, production activation or EB2 remains independently human-gated.
